_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior soffit prime+paint (enclosed eave underside). Context prefix SFIT (SoFfIT) — no collision with existing prefixes (CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM). Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). Single SF-based paintable item. Overhead work is the defining production characteristic.

paintable_items.name: Exterior soffit field surface
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item — soffit underside surface area (eave depth x roofline perimeter length). SF-based like siding, not LF-based like trim. Covers all soffit substrate types (wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement, vinyl). Surface ref soffit_field exists in id_registry surface_ids.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM. SFIT is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_SFIT_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_SFIT_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE, TSK_SFIT_SAND_PREP, TSK_SFIT_SPOT_PRIME_KNOTS, TSK_SFIT_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL, TSK_SFIT_FINISH_BRUSH_ROLL_1, TSK_SFIT_CUTIN_FASCIA, TSK_SFIT_SAND_INTERCOAT

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape/hardscape below, light fixture masking, adjacent fascia/frieze light masking when finished
Low-pressure wash (garden hose + soft brush), sand prep (80-120 grit wood / 220 grit vinyl scuff), seal fiber cement cut edges, caulk panel joints
3 substrate paths: acrylic wood primer + tannin spot-prime, field prime FC over factory prime (mandatory) or alkali-resistant on bare FC, bonding primer on vinyl. Conditional on substrate state.
First finish coat — brush/roll (default for vented), spray (non-vented only). Cut-in at fascia and frieze junctions.
Intercoat inspection. QT4: light sand between coats, dust removal. QT2: skipped (single coat).
Second finish coat. Same method constraints as first coat. QT2 may skip (single coat acceptable on primed surfaces).
Final inspection, overhead touch-up at edges and joints

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable soffit field area (square feet). Eave depth x roofline perimeter length.
Access type per elevation (ground/ladder/scaffold/lift). Height modifier stacks with overhead penalty.
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for NC specs.
paintscope_keys.notes: Already proposed/registered by sibling siding specs.

paintscope_keys.description: Classification of soffit vent construction (vented/non_vented). Determines whether spray application is eligible. Default assumption: vented (forces brush/roll).
Classification of soffit panel/board construction (solid_panel/tg_board). T&G boards have 20% higher labor due to joint complexity.
Landscape area directly below soffit work zone requiring drop cloth protection. Critical for overhead work — gravity pulls all drips straight down.
Adjacent walkway area below soffit requiring protection
Count of soffit-mounted light fixtures to mask (recessed lights, porch fixtures)

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — not applicable to soffit field per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine §5.4. Soffit is a large-area overhead field surface, not fine millwork. QT2 is economy (single finish coat acceptable on primed surfaces).

application_method.notes: brush_roll is PRIMARY default — valid for all soffit types (vented and non-vented). spray is CONDITIONAL on vent_type = non_vented. Vented soffit: brush_roll ONLY (spray drives paint into attic through perforations — FM-001 critical failure). spray_backroll NOT valid — back-rolling avoided on fiber cement; overhead back-rolling is impractical.

sheen.notes: Per Exterior_Color_Sheen_Configuration_Doctrine §3: soffits use flat or satin sheen. No semi-gloss or gloss — overhead surfaces show less gloss benefit, and lower sheen hides overhead application imperfections. Flat is most common soffit sheen.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for soffit field. EA for protection items, knot spot-prime count, edge seal count. LF for caulk joints and cut-in edges. FIXED for tool cleaning.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD: new wood T&G or plywood soffit — also used by convention for vinyl soffit (no dedicated SS_EXT_BARE_VINYL exists). SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY: fiber cement soffit with factory transit primer — field prime MANDATORY. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD: any substrate already field-primed. All SS_EXT_* states are in controlled_enums (recently added by sibling siding specs).

product_role.notes: Sealer for end-cut sealer on fiber cement. Specialty for VinylSafe/IR-reflective coating on vinyl soffit (conditional).

protection_level.notes: edge_only for landscape in brush/roll mode. full_cover for landscape/hardscape in spray mode (heavy overhead fallout). light_mask for adjacent finished fascia/frieze and light fixtures.

typical_relationship.notes: different_finish: fascia, frieze, rake, siding (trim vs body colors). same_finish: porch ceiling (often continuous same color).

surface_ids.notes: soffit_field, ext_trim_frieze, ext_trim_corner, ext_trim_window_casing, ext_trim_door_casing, siding_field, foundation_wall all exist in id_registry surface_ids entries_in_active_use. Research also references 'fascia' (proposed as ext_trim_fascia by SF_TRIM_EXT_NC), 'ext_trim_rake' (existing), and 'porch_ceiling' (proposed — future spec). Fascia and rake adjacencies are real but their surface_ids are proposed by the trim spec.

zone_ids.notes: Proposed by SF_TRIM_EXT_NC — reused here for siding masking when finished siding is below soffit work area

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — similar acrylic primer concept but siding-specific
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN — tannin-blocking exterior primer for cedar/redwood
SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — fiber cement field primer (shared concept with soffit FC path)
SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ALKALI — alkali-resistant primer for bare fiber cement
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — interior bonding primer, different substrate
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — siding finish, same product tier

proposed_systems.name: Exterior Acrylic Primer for Wood/FC Soffit
proposed_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior primer for wood soffit (full prime) and fiber cement soffit (field prime over factory prime — mandatory). Shared system because same product covers both wood and factory-primed FC.

proposed_systems.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Soffit
proposed_systems.notes: Spot-prime knots on cedar/redwood T&G soffit boards before full field prime. Not a full-surface system. Prevents tannin bleed-through.

proposed_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare Fiber Cement Soffit
proposed_systems.notes: Required for bare/damaged fiber cement soffit (pH 13.0). Reference product: SW Loxon Masonry Primer. Prevents saponification. Note: bare FC uses SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD by convention in soffit context when factory primer is damaged/absent.

proposed_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Vinyl Soffit
proposed_systems.notes: Bonding/adhesion primer for non-porous vinyl soffit (Insl-X STIX, BM Fresh Start). Chemical bond to PVC surface. Required before any topcoat on vinyl.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
proposed_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior paint. Flat to satin sheen. Standard residential grade. QT2 may use single coat.

proposed_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
proposed_systems.notes: Premium materials (SW Emerald, BM Aura or equivalent). Flat to satin. Light sand between coats. Mildew-resistant formulation recommended for sheltered soffit surface.

proposed_systems.name: Solar-Reflective Paint for Vinyl Soffit
proposed_systems.notes: CONDITIONAL: required when vinyl substrate AND color LRV < 55. VinylSafe/Colors for Vinyl IR-reflective technology. HARD STOP — standard dark paint on vinyl voids warranty and causes thermal distortion (FM-005). Only 100% acrylic latex binders.

material_system_prefix.notes: 4 substrate-driven primers (acrylic for wood/FC, tannin spot for wood knots, alkali-resistant for bare FC, bonding for vinyl) + 2 QT-driven finish systems + 1 conditional solar-reflective for vinyl dark colors. No QT5 (excluded for soffit field).

proposed_consumables.name: 80-Grit Sandpaper for Wood Soffit Prep
proposed_consumables.notes: 80-120 grit for wood soffit adhesion profile. Overhead use increases consumption.

proposed_consumables.name: Fiber Cement End-Cut Edge Sealer
proposed_consumables.notes: Seal field-cut edges on HardieSoffit panels. Prevents capillary moisture absorption (FM-006). May share product with CON_FCSD_END_SEALER.

proposed_consumables.name: Exterior Flexible Paintable Caulk for Soffit Joints
proposed_consumables.notes: Polyurethane or siliconized acrylic for soffit panel joints and soffit-to-fascia/frieze junctions.

proposed_consumables.name: 9-inch Roller Cover for Overhead Soffit
proposed_consumables.notes: 3/8 to 1/2 inch nap for smooth soffit panels. Higher consumption overhead due to dripping.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 413 (non-vented soffit)
proposed_consumables.notes: 413-515 tip for soffit spray application on non-vented solid panels. Only used when spray is eligible.

proposed_consumables.name: Plastic Sheeting for Ground Protection Below Soffit
proposed_consumables.notes: Ground protection below soffit work zone. Critical for overhead work — all drips fall straight down.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 prime + 2 finish coats — standard NC sequence at QT3/QT4
1 prime + 1 finish coat — economy QT2 on bare/factory-primed surfaces
2 finish coats only — when field prime already applied (SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD)
1 finish coat only — economy QT2 on field-primed surface

proposed_profiles.description: Acrylic primer coverage on soffit — 250-350 SF/gal on smooth panels. T&G rough-sawn: apply 1.15 surface_factor.
Alkali-resistant primer coverage on bare fiber cement soffit — 200-300 SF/gal (lower coverage on porous bare substrate, overhead application wastage).
Finish coat coverage on primed soffit — 250-350 SF/gal smooth panels. T&G rough-sawn: apply 1.15 surface_factor. Overhead application increases waste factor.

deduplication_notes: Fascia and frieze are separate spec scope (SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1). This spec handles soffit side of fascia-soffit junction and frieze-soffit junction. Trim spec handles the trim side.
Porch ceiling is separate scope (future SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_NC_v1). When porch ceiling is continuous with soffit, edge work at transition may need deduplication.
Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility — siding specs handle that.
Soffit-to-siding junction: frieze board typically separates them. No direct soffit-to-siding cut-in needed.
Top-down sequence: soffit is painted before siding body. Adjacent fascia/frieze protection depends on whether they are already finished at time of soffit work.

existing_modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS — ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50 (from sibling exterior specs)

proposed_modifiers.description: Overhead work penalty — ALL soffit tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: All tasks in this spec. Soffit work is 100% overhead.
proposed_modifiers.source: Research RF-003: overhead work reduces production rates by 25-40%. Calibrated to 1.35 (midpoint). Flag for field validation.
proposed_modifiers.stacking: Multiplicative with FAC_EXT_ACCESS. Example: ladder soffit = 1.35 (overhead) x 1.35 (height) = 1.82 total.

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: Finish application tasks on vented soffits. Brush/roll technique must avoid driving paint into vent perforations.
Brush/roll application tasks. T&G boards have many joints requiring brush attention to work paint into grooves.

proposed_modifiers.description: Surface texture modifier for material consumption
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: Material quantity calculation only. Rough-sawn plywood or T&G board soffit requires 15% more material per coat.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_SFIT_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_SOFFIT_FIELD MUST be used exactly as listed in this resolution's paintable_items
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Soffit Prime and Paint (New Construction)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior soffit — enclosed eave underside painting. Distinct scope from siding (overhead field surface), trim (LF-based non-overhead), and porch ceiling (future spec). Overhead work penalty is the defining production characteristic.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior soffit field surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM_ covers exterior soffit. Distinct from ITM_SIDING_FIELD (vertical, not overhead). SF-based measurement (eave depth x roofline perimeter).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Field Surface Area (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Referenced in PaintScope_Exterior_Key_Catalog.md but not yet in id_registry PS_ entries_in_active_use. First spec to consume this key.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Field Area Input (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_SURFACE_SF.SOFFIT_FIELD. SF UOM.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Vent Construction Type (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PaintScope key — captures whether soffit is vented or non-vented. Critical constraint: gates spray eligibility. No existing PS key captures this. Default assumption: vented.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Vent Type Input (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SOFFIT_VENT_TYPE. ENUM UOM (vented/non_vented).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Panel/Board Construction Type (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PaintScope key — captures whether soffit is solid panels or T&G boards. Drives 20% production rate modifier for T&G joint complexity.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Panel Type Input (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SOFFIT_PANEL_TYPE. ENUM UOM (solid_panel/tg_board).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fascia adjacent to soffit (light masking when finished)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone — fascia above soffit needs light masking when already finished to prevent roller spatter during soffit painting. Not in current zone_ids entries.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Acrylic Primer for Wood/FC Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Soffit-specific primer system covering wood and factory-primed fiber cement. Distinct from SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC (siding context) due to different coverage rates on overhead surfaces.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Spot primer for cedar/redwood T&G soffit knots. Not a full-surface system. No existing SYS_ covers soffit-specific tannin spot-priming.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare Fiber Cement Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Required for bare/damaged FC soffit (pH 13.0). Distinct from SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ALKALI (siding context) due to different overhead application rates.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bonding Primer for Vinyl Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Bonding primer for non-porous vinyl soffit panels. Distinct from SYS_PRIMER_BONDING (interior) and SYS_EXT_TRIM_PRIMER_BONDING (PVC trim) due to overhead application context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT2/QT3 soffit finish. Distinct from siding finish systems due to flat/satin sheen range and mildew-resistance focus.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT4 soffit finish with premium materials. Mildew-resistant formulation emphasized for sheltered soffit surface.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Solar-Reflective Paint for Vinyl Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Conditional system for vinyl soffit with LRV < 55. VinylSafe IR-reflective technology prevents thermal distortion (FM-005). No existing SYS_ covers soffit-specific solar-reflective coatings.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Acrylic Primer Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Soffit primer coverage (250-350 SF/gal smooth) differs from siding due to overhead application wastage and T&G texture factor.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Alkali-Resistant Primer Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Lower coverage on bare FC soffit (200-300 SF/gal) — porous substrate plus overhead wastage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Finish Coat Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Soffit finish coverage (250-350 SF/gal smooth) with overhead wastage factor.
